title: doctor offers rm -rf on the owner's checkout in a sandbox
what: doctor's leftover-folder check looks only at folders the current setup owns and never proposes deleting inside a relay checkout that is a git repository.
why: Found 30 Oct by the trial of relay on a copy of relay cleaned of relay (owner, 30 Oct: "Полагаю что для текущих задач будет не лишним проверить подключение relay к самому relay, очищенному от relay"); sandbox HOME, RELAY_HOME and RELAY_PROJECTS, claude stubbed. `relay doctor` with a fresh HOME printed 'FIX no leftover plugin folder (/Users/amidman/relay/plugins/core ... rm -rf ...)', a delete command aimed at the owner's real relay checkout, from a sandbox run.
failing_case: HOME and RELAY_HOME pointed at empty folders: `relay doctor` prints an rm -rf of /Users/amidman/relay/plugins/core.
pass_cases: the sandbox doctor run proposes no rm inside a git checkout
a real leftover cache folder is still reported
